import socket, time, sys, os, select, uuid, re

SOCK="/tmp/console.sock"
LOGFILE="/tmp/console.log"

class Console:
    def __init__(self):
        self.s=None
        self.log=open(LOGFILE,"ab")
    def connect(self, timeout=300):
        end=time.time()+timeout
        while time.time()<end:
            if os.path.exists(SOCK):
                try:
                    s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM)
                    s.connect(SOCK)
                    self.s=s
                    return
                except OSError:
                    pass
            time.sleep(0.5)
        raise RuntimeError("console socket not available")
    def _recv(self):
        try:
            d=self.s.recv(4096)
            if d:
                self.log.write(d); self.log.flush()
            return d
        except (BlockingIOError,):
            return b""
    def drain(self,t=0.3):
        end=time.time()+t
        while time.time()<end:
            d=self._recv()
            if not d:
                time.sleep(0.05)
    def read_until(self, marker, timeout=60, settle=0.0):
        if isinstance(marker,str): marker=marker.encode()
        buf=b""
        end=time.time()+timeout
        while time.time()<end:
            r,_,_=select.select([self.s],[],[],0.2)
            if r:
                d=self._recv()
                if d:
                    buf+=d
                    if marker in buf:
                        if settle:
                            time.sleep(settle)
                            # drain remainder
                            self.drain(settle)
                        return buf
            else:
                time.sleep(0.05)
        raise TimeoutError("timeout waiting for %r\n---buf---\n%s"%(marker,buf.decode(errors='replace')))
    def send(self,text,delay=0.1):
        self.s.sendall(text.encode())
        time.sleep(delay)

                    if re.search(rb"[#\$] $", buf):  # already at shell

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Drive the Alpine guest over the serial console:
- wait for login prompt, log in as root (no password)
- bring up networking (DHCP on eth0)
- generate SSH host keys
- configure sshd: PermitRootLogin yes, PasswordAuthentication yes
- set root password to 'password123'
- start sshd
- verify sshd is listening on port 22 inside the guest
"""
import sys
import time
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/.stella/vmrun")
from console_driver import Console

c = Console()
PASSWORD = "password123"


def run(cmd, prompt="localhost:~#", timeout=60):
    """Send a command, wait for the shell prompt, return elapsed."""
    c.reset_buffer()
    c.sendline(cmd)
    ok, el = c.expect(prompt, timeout=timeout)
    if not ok:
        snap = c.snapshot()
        print(f"[!] TIMEOUT ({el:.0f}s) waiting for prompt after: {cmd!r}", flush=True)
        print("---- buffer tail ----", flush=True)
        print(snap[-1500:], flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)
    print(f"[+] {cmd}  ({el:.0f}s)", flush=True)
    return el


def main():
    # 1. Wait for the login prompt
    print("[*] waiting for login prompt...", flush=True)
    ok, el = c.expect("login:", timeout=180)
    print(f"    login prompt seen: {ok} ({el:.0f}s)", flush=True)
    if not ok:
        print(c.snapshot()[-1500:], flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)

    # 2. Log in as root (no password on the ISO)
    c.sendline("root")
    ok, el = c.expect("localhost:~#", timeout=60)
    # Some Alpine prompts: 'localhost:~#' or just '#'. Accept a '#' fallback.
    if not ok:
        ok2, el2 = c.expect("#", timeout=10)
        if not ok2:
            print("[!] did not get shell prompt after login", flush=True)
            print(c.snapshot()[-1500:], flush=True)
            sys.exit(1)
    print(f"[+] logged in as root ({el:.0f}s)", flush=True)
    time.sleep(1)

    # 3. Reliable marker prompt so we can detect command completion robustly.
    #    Set PS1 to a unique marker.
    c.sendline("export PS1='STELLA##'")
    ok, el = c.expect("STELLA##", timeout=30)
    if not ok:
        print("[!] could not set PS1", flush=True)
        print(c.snapshot()[-1000:], flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)
    MARK = "STELLA##"

    # 4. Bring up networking: set eth0 up + DHCP. udhcpc is available on the live ISO.
    run("ip link set eth0 up", prompt=MARK, timeout=20)
    run("udhcpc -i eth0 -q -t 10 -n 2>&1 | tail -3", prompt=MARK, timeout=45)
    run("ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet || echo NO_IP", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)

    # 5. Generate SSH host keys (live ISO does not ship them).
    run("ssh-keygen -A 2>&1 | tail -2", prompt=MARK, timeout=40)

    # 6. Configure sshd to allow root login with a password.
    run("sed -i 's/^#\\?PermitRootLogin.*/PermitRootLogin yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)
    run("sed -i 's/^#\\?PasswordAuthentication.*/PasswordAuthentication yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)
    # Ensure the directive is present (append if sed found nothing to replace)
    run("grep -q '^PermitRootLogin yes' /etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo 'PermitRootLogin yes' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)
    run("grep -q '^PasswordAuthentication yes' /etc/ssh/sshd_config || echo 'PasswordAuthentication yes' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)

    # 7. Set root password.
    c.reset_buffer()
    c.sendline("passwd root")
    ok, el = c.expect("New password:", timeout=15)
    if not ok:
        print("[!] passwd did not prompt for new password", flush=True)
        print(c.snapshot()[-1000:], flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)
    c.sendline(PASSWORD)
    ok, el = c.expect("Retype", timeout=15)
    if not ok:
        # maybe different prompt
        ok, el = c.expect("password:", timeout=10)
    c.sendline(PASSWORD)
    ok, el = c.expect(MARK, timeout=15)
    print(f"[+] root password set ({el:.0f}s)", flush=True)

    # 8. Start sshd. First kill any existing, then start.
    run("killall sshd 2>/dev/null || true", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)
    run("/usr/sbin/sshd", prompt=MARK, timeout=20)
    # Verify it is listening
    run("netstat -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep ':22 ' || ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep ':22' || echo CHECKING_SSHD", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)
    # Also confirm sshd config parses
    run("/usr/sbin/sshd -t && echo SSHD_CONFIG_OK", prompt=MARK, timeout=15)

    print("[*] setup driver complete.", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
